Armor-Piercing only, at the price of Basic (this gun only). Autofire and Suppressive Fire only. Autofire uses 15 rounds; with fewer left it empties as Machine Gun 3. +2 on Suppressive Fire. If it Autofired last Round, its rating climbs by 1 (up to Machine Gun 7), using 5 more rounds per step. At ratings 6 and 7, a single 6 on the damage is a Critical Injury. Reloading takes three Reload Actions. Unmounted, without BODY 10+ or paired cyberarms, −2 MOVE while held.

Class: Excellent Quality Machine Gun • POWER
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire
Built-in: Auto-Compensator, Bipod, Power Rebuild, TUp (ROF 1, Very Heavy Melee) Stun Bayonet
Fabrication: Hansen’s not goin’ to let this one off its leash. (Cannot be fabricated, must be gifted or scavenged)

Item Compendium (2070) • Iconics
